dct_description_sm: Points that represent the location of bicycle parking infrastructure owned by both the City of Waterloo and private owners. Data pertaining to City of Waterloo racks are maintained by Active Transportation staffed and updated as new features are installed.Attributes within this dataset indicate the type of rack, owner, Location, and location description. For more information please see the City of Waterloo Cycling Map.
